review_description: His response was detailed, professional and timely.The solar panel plan was clear and the output required by the system was accurate and appropriate. The installation team were excellent. The right staffing with the right mix of skills required to complete the job in the time alotted. The follow-up post inspection, explanation of the inverter and connection to grid and system was superb.

Gardel were good to deal with and provided a good service. Components were good quality and pricing was good value. Local family company. The hot water switch extra was a good idea to further reduce power use.
Very busy! Took a while to get it sorted
